title: 🔗 Batch Link Cleaner
description: Clean a list of links before sharing or archiving them. Removes recognized campaign trackers while keeping the destination, useful query parameters, and URL fragment. It does not open links, follow...

inputs.name: batch-link-cleaner-trackers
inputs.label: Remove known campaign/ad trackers such as utm_* , gclid and fbclid

inputs.name: batch-link-cleaner-referrals
inputs.label: Also remove generic referral/coupon keys such as ref , aff and coupon (may change how a link works)

inputs.name: batch-link-cleaner-custom
inputs.label: Additional query keys to remove (optional, comma or newline separated)

formula: Interactive browser tool — no single closed-form formula (see description).
